intro.text: I'm in my {{education.year}} year of Computer Engineering at NUS, specialising in {{education.specialisation}}, with a minor in AI. I graduate in {{education.end|y}}.

Since {{roles.kabam.start|mon}} I've been a software robotics intern at {{roles.kabam.org}}, until {{roles.kabam.end|mm}}. From {{roles.kabam.field_start|mm}} to {{roles.kabam.field_end|mm}} I'm the solo on-site engineer deploying their latest autonomous patrol robot.
I build AI agents and robot software: agent memory and runtimes, vision models on a Jetson, and the tools we use to debug a robot in the field.
I'm looking for internships from {{seeking.start|month}}, in {{seeking.areas}}.

holo.text: I'm Holo. Scroll and I'll point out what matters, or click me and ask.

bullets.text: Accelerated SAM3 (Segment Anything Model) vision pipeline on the robot's Jetson Orin AGX with TensorRT, integrated with RTSP video streams and YOLO11 spatial overlays.

Conducted first ever SG field PoC as solo on-site robotics engineer for KABAM’s {{roles.kabam.robot}} model of Jul 2026, diagnosing LiDAR SLAM drift, Nav2 MPPI trajectory planning, precision docking, and MWAN3 multi-WAN bonding alongside remote firmware/hardware teams.
Architected ROS 2 diagnostics console and mobile mission-control interface: real-time telemetry inspection, manual safety override, LiDAR/costmap visualization, and CAN-bus system health.

holo.text: The Jetson Orin inside the patrol robot. He got SAM3 running faster on it with TensorRT.

what.text: An autonomous personal OS agent runtime that persists across machines, self-heals across model failures, and manages daily engineering workflows.

bullets.text: Context Engineering: Cut prompt tokens by 69% (109KB to 34KB per turn) using schema virtualization, dynamic manifest projection, and state compression.

fleet.text: Aedrion, Ariadne and aiko-agy are her development fleet: features are built and proven in them first, then Aiko adopts them.

more.text: 5-Tier Memory: Scaled to 11,800+ facts combining episodic hindsight, SQLite FTS5 keyword indexing, and dense embeddings fused via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF).
Autonomous Harness: 142 discrete skills executed through deterministic state machines; universal gateway orchestrating Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, and local models with automatic failover.
Local Multi-Modal Interface: GPU-accelerated local voice (Qwen3-TTS, Whisper), 3D VRM embodiment in three.js, and offline manga indexing across 245,000+ pages.

Engineered real-time Git AST merge-conflict resolution daemon that detects conflicting agent code edits early and serializes patches safely.

what.text: An on-device AI companion for elderly care providing non-intrusive fall and inactivity monitoring while preserving total household privacy.

bullets.text: Implemented on-device computer vision using MediaPipe and WASM in the browser, analyzing activity posture locally with zero raw camera frames leaving the device.
Built a 7-stage deterministic safety pipeline that validates all agent actions, verifies context freshness, and routes emergency alerts via a tiered state machine.
When she goes quiet past her usual window, AnAn walks the family contact tree on Telegram, one person at a time (daughter, son, neighbour), until one of them calls back.

what.text: A deterministic counter-drone decision console and 6-sensor asynchronous simulation, built by a team of {{projects.marsham.team}} at the {{projects.marsham.event}} 2026. His part: the sensor output pipeline simulation and the operator console.

bullets.text: Built the 6-sensor output pipeline simulation (radar, acoustic, RF, IFF, EO, OSINT) that feeds the team's counter-drone decision engine, which ranks threat tracks with verifiable rule receipts (monitor, jam, or intercept).
Architected operator run-and-verify console with mandatory human-in-the-loop override safety rails; all decisions logged deterministically with zero autonomous weapon firing.
Migrated telemetry to one canonical sensor producer and converted THALES WGS84 positions to local Cartesian (ENU); the team's system is backed by 236 automated unit and pipeline tests.
